why: The published map has two density readings: sliding 100-500 people/ha (default) and flat 100/ha (cautious alternative). The marketed share 0.337 was calibrated on Earth with city residents at the sliding reading, but both map options use it. A share calibrated at the flat reading should accompany the flat option.
method: Exactly the passing setting of calibration/greek_walls_20261114 'greece' (floodplain rule in production, heartland people at Frier 61.4 M, Greek wall circuits at their inhabited share, 270 km decision rules) with Earth city residents from the 'low' (flat 100/ha) reading instead of 'central'. Control: the 'central' reading through this script must reproduce the greek_walls 'greece' surface to float tolerance.
rules: Original supply decision unchanged. If it passes, its e95 is the flat-reading share; the map's flat option is then rebuilt at that share (sizes unchanged) and republished. If it fails, the flat option keeps 0.337 and the note says it is calibrated only at the sliding reading.
